# The Pooja Edit — by Pooja Dugar

> Pooja Dugar is an Indian fashion creator (@poojadugar_ on Instagram,
> @poojadugar on YouTube) who makes realistic, wearable clothes. thepoojaedit.in
> is her shop: The Label (her own designs) and The Closet (one-of-one
> pre-loved pieces from her own wardrobe). She also offers personal styling
> and shopping in Gurugram and Delhi NCR, and online, and video editing for
> creators and brands at studio.thepoojaedit.in. Ships across India.

## Shop

- The Label (`/label`): Pooja's own designs — kurtis, co-ord sets and linen,
  made in real sizes and small runs. New, made to order; ships in about 5-10
  business days.
- The Closet (`/closet`): Pooja's own wardrobe, passed on. Every piece is
  one-of-one and listed with its condition, measurements and any flaws. Once
  it sells it leaves the shop. Final sale; dispatches within about 2 working
  days.
- Shop my Looks: the products Pooja wears in her videos, on her LehLah page
  (https://lehlah.club/poojadugar). These are other brands' products sold by
  other retailers, not by this shop.

## Personal styling and shopping

- Page: `/styling`. In person in Gurugram and Delhi NCR; online over video
  call for clients elsewhere in India and abroad. Pooja can also shop in
  India and ship to clients abroad.
- Services and fees are listed on the page as Pooja sets them (some are a
  price range, some are quoted on request). Enquiries go through the form on
  the page or WhatsApp.
- Most of her styling clients live abroad (Australia, the UK and Europe, the
  USA and Canada, the UAE). She shops for them over video calls or WhatsApp
  photo shortlists, has pieces made or altered to their measurements, and
  sends them by courier: `/styling/nri`.
- Wedding, trousseau and festive shopping for brides and families:
  `/styling/wedding-shopping`.
- What personal styling costs in Delhi NCR and how her fees work (no
  commission; clothes are paid for separately): `/styling/personal-stylist-cost`.

## Video editing (Pooja Dugar Edit Studio)

- Site: https://studio.thepoojaedit.in
- Instagram Reels and Shorts, YouTube long-form, Instagram carousels and
  graphics, for lifestyle and fashion creators and brands, including UGC and
  raw footage to finished edit. Prices and turnaround are on that site.

## Ordering

- Payment: online only (UPI / card / netbanking) via Razorpay. Cash on
  delivery is not offered.
- Shipping: across India. See `/policies/shipping`.
- Returns differ by catalog, and each item shows its own policy on the product
  page and in the cart. In short: Label items can be returned for damage or a
  wrong item, or exchanged for size, if raised within 48 hours of delivery
  with an unboxing video; Closet pieces are final sale. The full, current
  terms are at `/policies/returns-exchanges`.
